title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.90
summary: Sicherer HTTPS-Zugriff auf Aufnahme-Archiv: kurzer H.264-Cloud-Playback-Relay, Kamerafilter und Archiv-Wiedergabe in privatem PHP-Portal 3.0.7.
changes: New read-only authenticated recording archive routes for cloud metadata and playback clips
Bound cloud recording media to four-second 540p H264/AAC MPEG-TS segments under 3.5MB
Enforce strict allowlists: no remote recording deletion, exports, schedule changes or full raw media downloads
PHP 3.0.7 private Plesk portal adds recording archive with camera/date filters and iPhone HLS player
Preserve recording originals, MySQL cloud data, user accounts and permanent camera installation ID
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.90
description: Read-only recording archive and mobile HLS playback through secure outbound-only HTTPS camera cloud relay
releaseNotes: Deploy private Plesk PHP 3.0.7 first, then update camera backend to 2.20.90. Clips are generated on demand at 540p/15fps, not full-resolution originals. Playback and login require the usual camera account credentials.
